feature_enabled.name: bead-feature-enabled
feature_enabled.commit_message: docs(boundaries): document attempt-resolution feature boundary commits
feature_enabled.build_notes: Reconciled 2026-09-03 (beadrs-da594f4b). The recorded commit 5bb28bf7b853be7ba244adf3ce4c76b8d1bd01e5 was lost with the 2026-09-02 twin-lineage force-push: it resolves in no clone (git cat-file -t fails) and no origin ref contains it. Its restored-lineage content twin is e38430e42d2d915e8035dbaf7bcd59b43e12acbb - same subject ('docs(boundaries): document attempt-resolution feature boundary commits') and author date (2026-09-01T15:45:58-04:00) - and is reachable from origin/main; that twin is the rebuild target (scripts/build-from-archive.sh e38430e42d2d915e8035dbaf7bcd59b43e12acbb --features attempt-resolution). git_commit above stays as built-from provenance, not a rebuild target: the binary's embedded version string is 'bead 0.2.6 (5bb28bf-dirty 2026-09-01T20:16:37Z)'. The binary artifact itself was committed in 266a4e5 (feat(pluck): set up pinned binaries and compatibility framework), an origin/main ancestor. Verified live 2026-09-03: on-disk sha256 matches this entry; capabilities reports attempt_outcome.supported=true with the full outcome and action sets plus resolve_receipt/resolve_request schemas and a live 'resolve' subcommand (resolve --help exits 0). sha256 is hash-only, not rebuild-verifiable (build.rs embeds a wall-clock timestamp) - verify by byte comparison against the committed pin, never by rebuilding.

pre_feature.name: bead-pre-feature
pre_feature.commit_message: chore(beadrs-4fcead71): release 0.2.4 — v0.2.3 tag landed behind a checkpoint commit
pre_feature.build_notes: Reconciled 2026-09-03 (beadrs-455a56ac). The original target, tag attempt-resolution-pre / commit 53dade07ff2b9afda87e67459a825ec7e138dafa, was lost with the 2026-09-02 twin-lineage force-push: it resolves in no clone and origin serves no such ref, so the documented compile fix (lease_valid_but_stale -> alive_but_stale, 3 occurrences in src/main.rs) has no tree left to apply to. That commit's restored-lineage content twin is 785e4bb8d5505018111f457b4935784470a6edb3 (same subject, author date). Rather than pin a second, divergent binary under this name, this entry points at the canonical pre-feature pin of the reconciled registry (pinned-binaries/commits.json 'pre_feature', pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md): the 0.2.4 baseline built from af023ad, whose content twin is ea4e317e697306275aa1a781497a133f472c0df5. Verified live 2026-09-03: --version reports 'bead 0.2.4 (af023ad 2026-09-01T19:14:12Z)'; sha256 matches pinned-binaries/bead-pre-feature.metadata.json; 'resolve' is an unrecognized subcommand; 'capabilities' output carries no attempt_* keys. sha256 is hash-only, not rebuild-verifiable (build.rs embeds a wall-clock timestamp) - verify by byte comparison against the committed pin, never by rebuilding.

feature_enabled.test_capability: ./bead-feature-enabled capabilities | jq '.attempt_outcome' (output is always JSON; --format is accepted by no pin)

pre_feature.verify: sha256sum pinned-binaries/bead-pre-feature (must match the pre_feature sha256 above; never rebuild to verify - the hash is not reproducible)
pre_feature.test_capability: ./pinned-binaries/bead-pre-feature capabilities (output carries no attempt_* keys; --format does not exist on 0.2.4)
